title: Bounded coherent image for proper morphisms over a Noetherian base
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme and p:Y→T proper [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Supply independent derived localizations on Y and T [def-pc-derived-category]. If A∈D(O_Y) has bounded coherent cohomology [pqf-def-coherent], then Rp_*A [def-pc-derived-direct-image] has bounded coherent cohomology on T. No relative flatness, finite Tor dimension, finite-free representative or pseudo-coherence conclusion is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 08E2, Lemma 36.11.3, specialized to proper p; Tag 02O5 for proper coherence and Tag 08D5 for the uniform upper bound

proof.text: Properness makes Y locally Noetherian. Finite local generators and the coherent kernel clause give finite local presentations of each coherent source module. Over an affine Noetherian base use the integral-ideal filtration, finite cohomology of its factors, and short-exact finite-cohomology extension to prove finite cohomology. The semilinear affine-base sections comparison transfers finiteness to higher direct images. Restriction to affine opens and their finite presentations give finite presentation of higher direct images; together with their quasi-coherence this gives coherence. These are private proved helpers, avoiding the cyclic finite-free-model module.

Represent A by a strictly bounded-below complex K and transport its coherent cohomology through the representing isomorphism. Apply the truncation hypercohomology spectral sequence to module pushforward. Its E2 terms are coherent by the preceding helpers and vanish at negative first index. Kernel and cokernel closure propagates coherence to every derived page. Descending induction on the finite abutment filtration, using coherent extension closure and its stable-page graded comparisons, proves coherence in each total degree. Below the source lower bound the filtration is both full and zero, proving image vanishing. Reuse the existing generic finite-filtration helper from the bounded-below quasi-coherent direct-image module via import all; its quasi-coherent image theorem is not used.

For each cohomology degree q choose the eventual higher-direct-image bound N(q) from the quasi-coherent module vanishing theorem over the compact target. Let c be the finite supremum of N(q)+max(q,0) over q in [a,b]. If p+q>c, the E2 term vanishes: for negative p use the spectral quadrant; for q outside [a,b] transport source vanishing and apply the additive right-derived functor; inside [a,b] arithmetic gives N(q)<=p. A zero E2 term stays zero on every derived page by induction through its kernel-cokernel construction. Every abutment graded piece is therefore zero above c. Descending induction from the zero last filtration step makes the abutment zero. Combine this upper bound with the lower bound and the coherent-abutment proof. An empty interval has supremum zero, and zero source or empty schemes require no extra assumptions. The zero-page induction is the existing private helper in HalfPlaneWeakConvergence, reused via import all; its weak-convergence theorem is not invoked.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08E2, 02O5, 02O6, 01XJ; V2 implements proper coherence below the cyclic finite-free-model module, and uses finite E2 support instead of shifting an unbounded derived bound.
